title: Calendar & Events
notes: listPage/infiniteScroll/urlPrefill intentionally not applicable: this is a spatial month/week/day grid, not a row list, so ListPage/DataTable/useInfiniteScroll archetypes don't fit; hoverActions likewise replaced by the detail-drawer edit/delete icons. reschedule already called via PATCH client.eventsApi.reschedule (was already correct, not POST as previously noted) but was unused by the UI — now wired to real drag-and-drop in month/week views (day view has a single column so drag is not meaningful there). Added FilterBar (search + event-type filter), EmptyState for zero-events-in-range and zero-events-on-selected-day, PageHeader with count, themed CSV export of the filtered/visible event set, and swapped the lead field from a bespoke Combobox to RelationCombobox (fetches/resolves via leadsApi). sendMessageDialog/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput are not applicable — events carry no contact email/phone/address/money fields. Editing already existed (edit dialog) so 'no editing' from the prior audit note no longer applies.
showcaseScript: Open the Calendar in month view
Create an all-day event linked to a lead
Drag the event to a new date to reschedule
Switch to week view and confirm it moved
